title: Community
intro: Connect with customers, grow your audience and build lasting relationships through the Echo Grid Community.

status.title: Rollout status
status.description: What is open right now. This reflects the live platform settings and changes only when Echo Grid opens a capability.
status.closedNote: Community is not yet available. Visiting this page does not enroll you or any customer, and nothing is published.
status.openNote: Customers can now choose to join Community. Participation is always voluntary and every customer decides for themselves.
status.unknownNote: We could not read the rollout status, so nothing is assumed to be available. Try again later.

summary.title: Participation summary
summary.hint: Shown here only once an approved, privacy-protected count exists.

feed.title: Community activity
feed.empty: Community activity will appear here when Community becomes available.
feed.openNotice: The customer Community Feed is open, but activity for businesses is not available yet.

what.title: What it is
what.body: Echo Grid Community is a shared space that connects customers and businesses across the Echo Grid network.

differs.title: How it differs from your loyalty program
differs.body: Your loyalty program belongs to your business. Community is separate: joining your loyalty program never makes a customer a Community member.

benefit.title: How your business can benefit
benefit.body: Over time, Community is meant to help customers discover businesses and help businesses reach people who chose to take part. This is not available yet.

voluntary.title: Participation is voluntary
voluntary.body: A customer joins Community only by choosing to, with their own explicit agreement. Reading this page never enrolls anyone.

publishing.title: Publishing, later
publishing.body: In the future, approved businesses may be able to share updates. Publishing is not available yet, and every post would be moderated.

privacy.title: Customer privacy
privacy.body: You will only ever see totals about your own customers, never who joined or what any customer does elsewhere.

rollout.title: Current availability
rollout.body: See the rollout status above for what is open today.

participation.title: Participation
participation.description: How many of your loyalty customers take part in Community.
participation.unavailableTitle: Participation totals could not be loaded
participation.unavailable: The participation totals could not be loaded right now. Nothing is shown rather than a guess; try again shortly.
participation.privacy: You will never see which individual customers joined, their points, or anything about customers of other businesses. Small groups are hidden so that no one can be identified.
participation.suppressed: Hidden to protect privacy: groups smaller than {min} are never shown.
participation.about: These are totals only. Small groups are hidden, and a figure is also hidden when the remaining group would be small.

hints.participants: Of those, customers who currently take part in Community.
hints.rate: Participants as a share of your loyalty customers.

posts.title: My Posts
posts.description: Draft updates for your customers. Every post is reviewed by Tentaship before it can appear in Community.
posts.unavailableTitle: Your posts could not be loaded right now. Try again shortly.
posts.closed: Publishing is not open yet. You can read your earlier posts here, but nothing can be created or changed until publishing is opened.
posts.statusUnknown: We could not read whether publishing is open, so nothing can be changed right now.
posts.forbidden: You can see Community, but your role cannot manage posts. Ask your business owner or an admin to publish for you.
posts.moderationNote: A post is visible to customers only after the platform has approved it, while your business profile is published and your business is active.
posts.awaitingNote: Waiting for the platform's review. You can edit it again after it has been decided.
posts.rejectedBecause: Not approved: {reason}. Edit the post and submit it again.

composer.rules: No formatting, mentions, hashtags, email addresses or phone numbers. Offers and promotions follow the same review as every other post.

errors.invalid: The post could not be saved. Check the text and the link against the rules above.
errors.conflict: This post cannot be changed in its current state.
errors.cap: The daily post limit for your business has been reached. Try again tomorrow.
errors.profile: Publish your business profile first; posts need a published profile and an active business.

insights.title: Insights
insights.description: How your Community posts perform, from events the platform recorded itself.
insights.unavailableTitle: Insights could not be loaded right now. Try again shortly.
insights.forbidden: You can see Community, but your role cannot view insights.
insights.suppressed: Hidden to protect privacy: figures from fewer than {min} customers are never shown.

impressions.label: Post impressions
impressions.hint: Times your posts were shown to signed-in customers (once per customer, post and day).

reach.label: Unique reach
reach.hint: Different customers who were shown your posts.

engagements.label: Link opens
engagements.hint: Times customers opened a link in your posts (once per customer, post and day).

newFollowers.label: New followers
newFollowers.hint: Customers who chose to follow your business in this period.

notMeasured.visits: Business profile visits: customers have no profile page to visit yet, so none are counted.
notMeasured.attribution: Loyalty enrollment and acquisition attribution: no attribution model has been approved, so no conversion figure is shown.

insights.privacy: You never see which customers were reached, followed or opened a link. Figures cover posts shown in the Community Feed only.
